Super-Earth in Tau Ceti where Ryland Grace and Rocky harvest natural Astrophage predators (Taumoeba).
Strategic inner-colony frontier sector in the Halo UNSC astrometric network.
Lithium-rich extrasolar world beyond the Ring Gates settled by Belter refugees and Royal Charter Energy in Cibola Burn.

Major space station orbiting Pell’s World at Tau Ceti; fulcrum of the Company Wars between Earth Fleet and Union merchanters.
Target of Frank Drake’s pioneering 1960 Project Ozma SETI search scanning near the 1.420 GHz neutral hydrogen line.

sol.x: Excavation site of the Tycho Magnetic Anomaly 1 (TMA-1) monolith on the Moon, beaming a radio signal toward Saturn and Jupiter upon exposure to sunlight.
Giant planet converted into a miniature sun named Lucifer by self-replicating monoliths in 2010: Odyssey Two.
Jovian ocean moon transformed into a nascent sun-warmed biosphere in 2010: Odyssey Two ("All these worlds are yours except Europa. Attempt no landing there.").
Two-tone Saturnian moon whose bright equatorial oval houses the TMA-2 Star Gate monolith in the 1968 novel 2001: A Space Odyssey.
Volcanic Jovian moon hosting the primary Earth Alliance jumpgate providing hyperspace access to the Solar System.
Subsurface domed settlements and headquarters of the Free Mars movement fighting for independence from Earth.
First settlement (Underhill) and the elevator tether city (Sheffield atop Pavonis Mons) chronicled across two centuries of planetary transformation.
Inner Martian moon transformed into an orbital transfer terminal and cable counterweight before its catastrophic de-orbiting in the 2061 revolution.
Vast city mounted on thermal-expansion tracks that rolls continuously around Mercury’s equator to stay inside the habitable twilight zone.
Enigmatic megalithic monument carved from water ice discovered at the north pole of Pluto, standing untouched for over a century.
Exploration habitat in Acidalia Planitia where botanist Mark Watney survives for 549 sols using potato farming and hydrazine extraction.
Five-sphere pressurized lunar bubble city near Apollo 11, sustained by tourism and solar/nuclear oxygen smelting.
Scientific observation base and headquarters of Project Spaceguard tracking the 50-kilometer alien cylinder Rama during its perihelion slingshot.
Commercial hydrogen mining colony on Saturn’s moon Titan supplying reaction mass across the Solar System in Imperial Earth.
Encased in thick planetary ice, Pluto’s moon Charon is revealed in 2149 to be a dormant mass relay, unlocking instantaneous interstellar transit.
Subterranean alien ruins discovered in Promethei Planitia on Mars, revealing mass-effect physics and interstellar blueprints.
Deep-shaft underground mining city on Mars housing the Deimos Staryards offices and industrial extraction workforce.
Historic Saturnian colony beneath Titan’s dense nitrogen atmosphere dedicated to preserving pre-evacuation Earth traditions.
Thriving crater metropolis on Mars serving as humanity’s primary commercial and cultural capital after the devastation of Earth.
Terraformed oceanic moon of Jupiter dominated by fishing docks and coastal ports; homeworld of former ISSP officer Jet Black.
Frigid, sparsely populated Jovian moon with snowy domed cities and desolate industrial compounds.
Gas giant whose gravitational capture threatens Earth during the acceleration flyby, overcome by igniting Jupiter’s hydrogen-oxygen mix.
Cryogenic proving ground on Charon where recruit William Mandella and the UNEF force endure brutal survival drills in 30 Kelvin conditions.
Asteroid 433 Eros converted into the subterranean International Fleet Command School where Ender conducts the decisive simulation campaigns.
High lunar orbit sector hosting the International Fleet Battle School where gifted children compete in zero-gravity battle rooms.
Spherical Einstein-Rosen wormhole orbiting Saturn providing a gateway to the supermassive black hole Gargantua, later orbited by the cylinder habitat Cooper Station.
Permanent lunar research and water-mining installations established by NASA and the Soviet space program at the lunar south pole.
sol.a: Ronald D. Moore / Matt Wolpert / Ben Nedivi

sol.x: First permanent Martian research colony founded in 1995 during the competitive tri-party expedition between NASA, Helios, and the USSR.
sol.a: Ronald D. Moore / Matt Wolpert / Ben Nedivi

sol.x: Crossed the heliopause into interstellar space in 2012; heading toward a 1.6-ly flyby of Gliese 445 in ~40,000 years.
Crossed the heliopause into interstellar space in 2018; heading toward a 1.7-ly flyby of Ross 248 in ~42,000 years.
First spacecraft to traverse the Asteroid Belt and encounter Jupiter (1973); drifting toward Aldebaran over ~2 million years.
First spacecraft to encounter Saturn (1979); escaping the Solar System toward the constellation Scutum and Aquila.
Fifth solar-escape spacecraft; conducted flybys of Pluto (2015) and Kuiper Belt contact binary 486958 Arrokoth (2019).
First planetary atmosphere probed (Venera 4) and first robotic surface landing on another world (Venera 7 in 1970).
Site of six crewed Apollo lunar landings (1969–1972) and numerous robotic sample-return missions.
Planetary surface explored by Viking, Pathfinder, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity, and Perseverance searching for ancient biosignatures.
First asteroid orbited and landed upon by a spacecraft (NEAR Shoemaker in February 2001).
Carbonaceous near-Earth asteroid sampled by NASA’s OSIRIS-REx mission in 2020, delivering pristine primordial material to Earth.
Primitive C-type asteroid sampled by JAXA’s Hayabusa2 spacecraft in 2018–2019, returning sub-surface organics and amino acids.
Jupiter-family comet orbited by ESA’s Rosetta spacecraft and touched down upon by the Philae lander in November 2014.
Site of ESA’s Huygens probe landing in January 2005, the most distant landing ever conducted in the Solar System.
Premier infrared space observatory orbiting the Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange point, characterizing exoplanet atmospheres and deep-space targets.
Smooth ice-covered Jovian moon containing twice the liquid water of all Earth’s oceans combined beneath a 15–25 km ice shell, target of Europa Clipper.

gaia-6412595290592307840.x: Agricultural UNSC Outer Colony orbiting Epsilon Indi; site of humanity’s first contact with the Covenant in 2525.
Idyllic Earth-like agricultural world in the Epsilon Indi system, devastated during the Pak Protector fleet invasion.
Spectacular directly imaged cold Jovian world revealed by JWST MIRI coronagraphy at 10.65 and 15.5 microns.
Cold super-Jupiter directly imaged by JWST MIRI at 12 light-years, the coldest and oldest exoplanet ever imaged around a Sun-like star.

hip-30438.x: Third planet of Canopus; harsh desert world and sole source of the geriatric spice melange in the Known Universe.
F0Ib supergiant star 310 light-years away; home system of Karellen and the Overlords overseeing humanity’s evolutionary culmination in Childhood’s End.
